statement: Every order-four element of the full loop-outer group of the once-punctured torus has global multiplier one. Every finite two-subgroup therefore has multiplier image in the two global units plus or minus one, determined by its 2-adic coordinate.
depends_on: D43 involution signs and quartic multiplier square; D46 actual quartic lift; D50 finite two-subgroup list and dyadic quartic sign; D68 actual dihedral quotient and retained double-cover matrices; D69 integral positive-square action on the rotation cover; A2/A7 closed surface duality comparisons; A-KochloukovaZalesskii2007 Theorem 2 and Corollary 2 with its Section 2 proof; the explicit character extensions and multiplicative spectral sequence proved here
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Part D(b), full loop-outer finite actions in type (1,1)
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The actual full cusp-filling quotient N/K and its maximal pro-two map are retained, and the dual injection is characterized in both directions by vanishing on the two peripheral generators. The original Kochloukova-Zalesskii author PDF was reopened: Theorem 2, Corollary 2, and the Section 2 infinite-index lemma and Demushkin fixed-group proof were read directly. Each twisted finite-section action is nonidentity on integral homology by the specified rank-two minus-identity summand.
notes: A negative odd quartic coordinate would give the D69 type-(q,2) cover. Its actual closed filling has pro-two character module equal to the orthogonal direct sum of the rank-two averaged part and the rank-2(q-1) nontrivial deck part. The positive square acts by minus identity on the first and identity on the second, so it is a nonidentity actual involution acting trivially on mod-two first cohomology. Odd deck averaging is an integral self-adjoint idempotent for the unimodular surface cup form. Thus its fixed integral summand contains two characters with nonzero reduced cup product. Their integral extensions to the cyclic semidirect product kill every finite section. Every associated Demushkin fixed group is free pro-two, so the cup restricts to zero on every exact direct-product normalizer. Brown injectivity in degree three contradicts the nonzero associated graded class u times the surface class; the multiplicative Hochschild-Serre sequence collapses because every first-cohomology class extends and its cups generate the surface class. This excludes all negative quartic coordinates. No finite-action conjugacy, full fixed-subgroup recognition, or scalar cubic exclusion is asserted.
computational_checks: The exact finite dihedral-cover and integral-module identities used as input are certified in code/part_c/torus_quartic_dihedral_d68.py and code/part_c/torus_quartic_bad_prime_d69.py. The new degree-three restriction proof is analytic and makes no new computational assertion.
